opening.argument: The video identifies its subject as a purported Apple support scammer and explicitly frames the activity as scambaiting, including the description's direction to “Start Scambaiting.” The exchange exposes the caller's conduct: the caller asks for gift-card value while claiming it will be reimbursed, identifies the interaction as Apple support, and presses for additional cards. The participant directly challenges that conduct by asking, “Yeah, why are you trying to scam people out of money?” These facts present an investigation or test of the caller, rather than a solicitation by the video itself. The purported refund notification is not established as authentic or as proof that any refund occurred.
